title: Ethiopia Digital Foundations Project (P171034): Implementation Support Mission Aide-Mémoire, September 30 – October 10, 2024
why_not: Names only a planned 'WoredaNet upgrade' (bandwidth supply estimated US$12.5m, bid documents under review) and never says woreda or local government offices are to be connected; the later aide-memoire of February 2025, already held, covers the same upgrade.
